verdict.rationale: Kit is an email-marketing platform, so in-product AI insights are a fair question, but the evidence shows no native AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Kit. The Kit MCP only exposes account data to external AI clients, and stats endpoints and engagement scoring are raw analytics rather than AI-generated insights; both are adjacent capabilities that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
